text.arabic_uthmani: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍۢ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا

words.gloss_range: opening connector that carries the prior restraint frame into a fresh commanded declaration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) can coordinate with what precedes or resume a new unit, and both pressures matter at the boundary. Joined to {{ar:قُلِ}} ({{tr:quli}}), it launches the whole ayah as commanded speech after the restraint instructions of 18:28, so the truth declaration, choice clauses, punishment, and coda remain inside an instructed public utterance.

topics.headline: continued commanded speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as carried command-speech, not as a detached slogan.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as carried command-speech, not as a detached slogan.

words.gloss_range: singular imperative of public saying that introduces the truth-source declaration
words.root_gloss_range: speech command and public declaration; locally the imperative assigns delivery, not origin
words.prose: {{ar:قُلِ}} ({{tr:quli}}) is a second-person singular command, so the Prophet delivers rather than originates the statement. The kasra is a liaison trace before {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}), and the larger payoff is structural: commanded speech installs the truth-source frame before the paired who-wills clauses can be heard as choices.

topics.headline: messenger as commanded transmitter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is made the transmitter of a sourced declaration before the audience is invited to respond.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is made the transmitter of a sourced declaration before the audience is invited to respond.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative truth declaration, with an accepted accusative variant as a parsing contrast
words.root_gloss_range: fixedness, reality, rightness, and binding due; locally the definite noun grounds the choice pair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) stands in the standard reading as a nominative nominal declaration: the truth is from your Lord. The accepted accusative reading narrows the issue rather than replacing it; it can make the truth the object of saying, while the local standard grammar lets definite truth stand before belief and covering as the fixed reality to which both responses answer.

topics.headline: definite truth as source pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that choice is framed after a determinate truth-source claim, while the case variant shows the same pressure point can also be heard as saying the truth.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL payoff survives, but local grammar and reference evidence limit the claim: The reader notices that choice is framed after a determinate truth-source claim, while the case variant shows the same pressure point can also be heard as saying the truth.

words.gloss_range: source-marking preposition completing the truth-source claim
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes source the core of the opening claim. It attaches the truth to {{ar:رَّبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}), so the phrase does more than add a location of authority; it completes the proposition by saying where the declared truth comes from.

topics.headline: source rather than human construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening proposition hinges on origin: the truth is sourced from the addressees Lord.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the opening proposition hinges on origin: the truth is sourced from the addressees Lord.

words.gloss_range: genitive Lord-title with second-person plural suffix as the source of truth
words.root_gloss_range: nurture, mastery, ownership, and ordering authority; locally relational Lordship sources the truth
words.prose: {{ar:رَّبِّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}) closes the source phrase with a plural possessive address. The truth comes from the audience's own Lord, a word carrying nurture and sovereignty together; after 18:28's face-seeking, this makes the source claim relational rather than abstract. The following belief and disbelief clauses are responses to a sustaining authority already named as theirs.

topics.headline: plural audience bound to their Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both branches of response are addressed under the same relational Lordship, not under an abstract source.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that both branches of response are addressed under the same relational Lordship, not under an abstract source.

words.gloss_range: consequence connector branching from declared truth into the first conditional
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the source declaration into a consequence: because the truth is from your Lord, the ayah now branches into whoever wills. The repeated short {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) sounds across the choice frame make the movement from declaration to answer audible.

topics.headline: choice downstream from truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the who-wills formula is grammatically downstream from the declared truth-source.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the who-wills formula is grammatically downstream from the declared truth-source.

words.gloss_range: conditional pronoun opening the first volitional branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) is conditional rather than interrogative, but it keeps the open who-pressure underneath. The first branch does not name a fixed group; it creates a distributive slot that any hearer can occupy before belief is supplied as the answer.

topics.headline: first open whoever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject of response is left open and repeatable: whoever enters the branch.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the subject of response is left open and repeatable: whoever enters the branch.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb in a conditional frame, with the willed object omitted until the answer clause
words.root_gloss_range: willing and thingness; locally volition becomes the shared switch for either response
words.prose: {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}) is perfect in form but conditional in function, giving the will-act both decisiveness and openness. Its object is omitted until the following answer supplies belief, and the root's link between willing and thingness makes the choice feel like a concrete moral fact taking shape. The same verb will return in the disbelief branch, making will the shared switch rather than the moral result itself.

topics.headline: decisive but open willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that willing is presented as the same decisive act before belief or disbelief gives it moral direction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that willing is presented as the same decisive act before belief or disbelief gives it moral direction.

words.gloss_range: apodosis connector before the belief-command limb
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the first conditional answer. Joined to the command-lām and verb, it compresses consequence, command-shape, and belief into one immediate response unit, while its counterpart later gives the disbelief branch the same formal architecture.

topics.headline: belief as conditional answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is syntactically the answer to the first whoever-wills condition.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that belief is syntactically the answer to the first whoever-wills condition.

words.gloss_range: lām al-amr governing the belief verb into jussive mood
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l}}) governs {{ar:يُؤْمِن}} ({{tr:yuʾmin}}) as a third-person jussive answer to whoever wills. The form can sound permissive, command-shaped, and warning-laden at once, but its local grammar makes each whoever individually accountable for the belief response.

topics.headline: third-person jussive response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is phrased as a distributive let-him response, not as a bare report.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that belief is phrased as a distributive let-him response, not as a bare report.

words.gloss_range: jussive imperfect of belief in the first response limb
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, safety, and entering reliable commitment; locally the positive pole opposite covering
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِن}} ({{tr:yuʾmin}}) is governed by the command-lām and occupies the first answer slot. Its root field brings security and trust into the choice, so after {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) is declared, the positive branch is an active movement into trust rather than a neutral mental label.

topics.headline: belief as active security-trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believing is not bare opinion; it is the active trust-security branch opposed to covering denial.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that believing is not bare opinion; it is the active trust-security branch opposed to covering denial.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the second conditional to the first as its counterpart
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second whoever-clause with the first. It keeps the disbelief branch parallel and full, so the ayah presents two real syntactic limbs even though the following consequence will disclose their unequal moral weight.

topics.headline: coordinated opposite branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is coordinated as the counterpart branch, not introduced as a separate aside.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is coordinated as the counterpart branch, not introduced as a separate aside.

words.gloss_range: second conditional pronoun reopening the subject slot for the opposite branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) is repeated instead of replaced by a shortcut pronoun. That full repetition gives the rejection branch its own open subject slot, so the later label wrongdoers arrives as consequence rather than as an initial name.

topics.headline: repeated whoever for rejecter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejecter is not named in advance but self-selects through the repeated whoever frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the rejecter is not named in advance but self-selects through the repeated whoever frame.

words.gloss_range: second perfect conditional will verb mirroring the first branch
words.root_gloss_range: volition as morally uncolored until routed into its answer; locally the identical trigger for disbelief
words.prose: {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}) repeats the first will verb exactly. The will-act itself is not lexically darkened; the following {{ar:يَكْفُرْ}} ({{tr:yakfur}}) supplies its moral direction, so the punishment clause answers a fully articulated choice rather than an incidental failure.

topics.headline: same will, opposite direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is placed under the same will grammar as belief, intensifying responsibility rather than weakening it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is placed under the same will grammar as belief, intensifying responsibility rather than weakening it.

words.gloss_range: apodosis connector before the disbelief-command limb
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the second conditional answer just as the earlier connector marked belief. Here the permission-shaped grammar darkens because {{ar:إِنَّآ}} ({{tr:innā}}) follows immediately with prepared punishment, turning the formal let-him frame into warning.

topics.headline: threatening apodosis connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that formal symmetry masks pragmatic asymmetry: this answer clause moves straight toward threat.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that formal symmetry masks pragmatic asymmetry: this answer clause moves straight toward threat.

words.gloss_range: lām al-amr governing the disbelief verb into a threat-colored jussive
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l}}) mirrors the earlier jussive particle but now governs {{ar:يَكْفُرْ}} ({{tr:yakfur}}). The grammar performs equality of choice, while the surrounding context reveals asymmetry: this command-shape functions as go-ahead warning, not encouragement.

topics.headline: command-shaped rejection limb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same command particle used for belief now forms a threatening concession for disbelief.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the same command particle used for belief now forms a threatening concession for disbelief.

words.gloss_range: jussive disbelief verb, locally Form I covering-denial rather than a causative form
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, and protective covering; locally covering the declared truth

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the Form I root comparison for the local disbelief verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَكْفُرْ}} ({{tr:yakfur}}) is jussive under the command-lām, but its lexical force is direct covering-denial. The bundle tag is narrowed by standard form evidence: locally this is Form I {{ar:كَفَرَ}} ({{tr:kafara}})-type covering, not causative making others disbelieve, so responsibility remains with the one who wills after truth has been declared.

topics.headline: direct covering of declared truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is pictured as a directly chosen covering of the truth just named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL payoff survives, but local grammar and reference evidence limit the claim: The reader notices that disbelief is pictured as a directly chosen covering of the truth just named.

words.root_display: no lexical root (emphatic particle with first-person plural pronoun)
words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus divine first-person plural pronoun opening the punishment assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّآ}} ({{tr:innā}}) interrupts the permission-shaped choice frame with emphatic divine speech. The person movement is sharp: command to the Prophet, address to the plural audience, then divine we announcing that consequence is not negotiable.

topics.headline: choice gives way to certain consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from human volition to emphatic divine consequence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices the shift from human volition to emphatic divine consequence.

words.gloss_range: perfect first-person plural preparation verb, with root-derivation dispute converging on readiness
words.root_gloss_range: counting, preparing, arranging, and disputed readiness-at-hand; locally completed divine preparation
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْتَدْنَا}} ({{tr:aʿtadnā}}) is perfect, so the prepared fire is grammatically complete when the threat is heard. The derivation dispute is narrowed rather than erased: whether heard through counting/preparing or readiness at hand, the local payoff is arranged, available consequence after the human will verbs.

topics.headline: prepared and already readied fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is presented as already prepared, not improvised after disbelief.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL payoff survives, but local grammar and reference evidence limit the claim: The reader notices that punishment is presented as already prepared, not improvised after disbelief.

words.gloss_range: preposition linking divine preparation to the target class, with benefactive grammar inverted
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) attaches the prepared fire to {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}). Its allocation grammar can sound benefactive, but the object is fire, so for them becomes an ironic against-them assignment that will contrast with the positive allocation in 18:31.

topics.headline: for them as against them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a normally allocative for-phrase is turned into hostile assignment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that a normally allocative for-phrase is turned into hostile assignment.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle naming the punished class
words.root_gloss_range: injustice, darkness, displacement, and putting things out of place; locally the moral category produced by covering truth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}) is a definite plural active participle, naming a recognizable class rather than one isolated act. After {{ar:يَكْفُرْ}} ({{tr:yakfur}}), the label translates covering truth into displacement, injustice, and darkness, so punishment is assigned to wrongdoers rather than to a neutral alternative party.

topics.headline: covering renamed as wrongdoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah converts the choice to cover truth into the category wrongdoers.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the ayah converts the choice to cover truth into the category wrongdoers.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object of preparation, immediately expanded into enclosing environment
words.root_gloss_range: fire and light share a broad field; locally the destructive fire branch is selected
words.prose: {{ar:نَارًا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) is the accusative object of preparation. The broader root field can set destructive fire beside guiding light, but the local branch is narrowed to fire: an indefinite, terrifying prepared substance that the next words transform from object into surrounding habitat.

topics.headline: indefinite fire becoming habitat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prepared object is concrete fire that immediately becomes an enclosing environment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL payoff survives, but local grammar and reference evidence limit the claim: The reader notices that the prepared object is concrete fire that immediately becomes an enclosing environment.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form IV verb making the fire enclosure complete around them
words.root_gloss_range: surrounding, enclosing, guarding, walling, and encompassing; locally sealed containment
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَاطَ}} ({{tr:aḥāṭa}}) is perfect and Form IV, presenting complete encompassment as already accomplished in the scene. The fire is not only hot; it has a perimeter, a wall-like containment that inverts protective enclosure into prison-like punishment, so the cave-like geometry of refuge becomes sealed confinement.

topics.headline: total enclosure already pictured
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is spatially sealed before the relief-seeking scene begins.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that punishment is spatially sealed before the relief-seeking scene begins.

words.gloss_range: preposition selected by the enclosure verb to mark those surrounded
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is selected by {{ar:أَحَاطَ}} ({{tr:aḥāṭa}}) and marks the object encompassed. It places the punished group inside the enclosure, while the later {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) before water will mark the instrument of their anti-relief.

topics.headline: the encompassed people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the precise spatial relation: the wrongdoers are the contents of the enclosure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices the precise spatial relation: the wrongdoers are the contents of the enclosure.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun referring back to the wrongdoers and beginning the punishment-scene chain
words.prose: {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) routes the enclosure back to {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}). This pronoun begins continuity through the scene: the group enclosed here is the group that will seek relief and then be answered with scalding liquid.

topics.headline: same group carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the enclosed group and the later help-seeking group are referentially the same.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the enclosed group and the later help-seeking group are referentially the same.

words.gloss_range: rare possessed enclosure noun functioning as the subject that surrounds them
words.root_gloss_range: quadriliteral enclosure, tent, pavilion, or court-wall imagery; locally punishment architecture
words.prose: {{ar:سُرَادِقُهَا}} ({{tr:surādiquhā}}) is the nominative subject of the surrounding verb, and its suffix points back to the fire. The rare pavilion or court-enclosure word is inverted: what could evoke an honored tent becomes the fire's own alien architecture, and the heavy quadriliteral sound reinforces the strange sealed texture of this hapax-like containment image.

topics.headline: the fire owns its strange enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a rare pavilion-wall word turned into the fire own architecture of confinement.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices a rare pavilion-wall word turned into the fire own architecture of confinement.

words.gloss_range: connector moving from completed containment to a conditional relief-seeking scenario
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the static enclosure to an active conditional scene. It coordinates the relief-inversion with the already completed containment, deepening punishment from being trapped to being answered with harm.

topics.headline: new scene after sealed enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah adds anti-relief after confinement rather than merely describing one punishment detail.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the ayah adds anti-relief after confinement rather than merely describing one punishment detail.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle introducing possible relief-seeking within an already sealed punishment scene
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) introduces relief-seeking as conditional and uncertain, not as an escape route. It comes after completed enclosure, so the hypothetical act can only show what happens inside the sealed scene when aid is sought.

topics.headline: if after the walls close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the if-clause does not reopen escape; it stages futility inside enclosure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the if-clause does not reopen escape; it stages futility inside enclosure.

words.gloss_range: Form X active jussive rescue-seeking under the conditional particle
words.root_gloss_range: aid, rescue, relief, and urgent help; locally a request for outside relief from confinement
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟}} ({{tr:yastaghīthū}}) is governed by {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) and uses Form X, the seeking form. The trapped group acts only by requesting rescue, and the repeated root in the next verb makes the cry and its answer inseparable before the answer is exposed as mock relief.

topics.headline: dependent cry for rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the morphology itself encodes dependence: they seek rescue from outside the condition.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the morphology itself encodes dependence: they seek rescue from outside the condition.

words.gloss_range: passive jussive answer to the rescue request, with the agent suppressed and the medium foregrounded
words.root_gloss_range: aid and rescue; locally the same relief root is inverted through passive reception and scalding instrument
words.prose: {{ar:يُغَاثُوا۟}} ({{tr:yughāthū}}) structurally answers the cry for help, but passive voice suppresses the responder and leaves the recipients exposed to what is given. The same relief root survives, yet the following instrument turns aid into controlled torment.

topics.headline: relief returned as torment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested rescue is answered in the same root but reversed into helpless reception of harm.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the requested rescue is answered in the same root but reversed into helpless reception of harm.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition marking the medium by which they are supposedly relieved
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the next noun as the instrument of the supposed relief. The earlier {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marked people inside enclosure; this one marks the medium that reaches them, linking place and process through repeated prepositional grammar.

topics.headline: means of the false aid
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the irony enters through the instrument slot: aid by water becomes punishment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the irony enters through the instrument slot: aid by water becomes punishment.

words.gloss_range: indefinite water noun governed as instrument and specified by the following simile
words.root_gloss_range: water as familiar life, provision, and cleansing; locally inverted into punishment-liquid

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the instrumental preposition later in the sequence

words.prose: {{ar:مَآءٍۢ}} ({{tr:māʾin}}) is governed by the instrumental {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and remains indefinite until the simile specifies it. The broad life-giving water field is narrowed here by context into scalding anti-relief; even the root dispute leaves the familiar word morphologically unsettled while the scene makes it punitive.

topics.headline: life-water turned scalding medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the most familiar life-substance becomes the instrument of anti-relief once defined by the muhl simile.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL payoff survives, but local grammar and reference evidence limit the claim: The reader notices that the most familiar life-substance becomes the instrument of anti-relief once defined by the muhl simile.

words.gloss_range: comparison particle governing the named source of the simile
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) marks explicit comparison. It keeps the liquid grammatically water while forcing the reader to imagine it through {{ar:ٱلْمُهْلِ}} ({{tr:al-muhl}}), using a familiar target to disclose an alien punishment texture.

topics.headline: comparison from water to muhl
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the water is not simply renamed; it is visualized through a horrifying comparison.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the water is not simply renamed; it is visualized through a horrifying comparison.

words.gloss_range: definite simile source naming hot viscous residue or molten substance
words.root_gloss_range: delay/respite and thick muhl substance; locally the substance branch defines the water texture
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُهْلِ}} ({{tr:al-muhl}}) is the definite source of the simile. Its range between oil-dregs and molten metal is not a problem to solve away; both preserve hot viscosity, while the broader delay/respite field darkly turns any hope of reprieve into material contact that clings and burns.

topics.headline: viscous punishment substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the liquid texture: hot, viscous, clinging, and materially defined before it sears.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices the liquid texture: hot, viscous, clinging, and materially defined before it sears.

words.gloss_range: imperfect active verb describing what the muhl-like liquid does
words.root_gloss_range: roasting, grilling, and searing; locally a vivid surface-burning action against faces
words.prose: {{ar:يَشْوِى}} ({{tr:yashwī}}) turns the muhl-like description into action. The subject can be understood from the water, the muhl-like substance, or the fire scene, but the nearest scalding medium narrows the reading; the verb imports roasting language into punishment and directs it toward exposed faces.

topics.headline: roasting verb applied to faces
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simile becomes bodily effect through a marked cooking/searing verb.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the simile becomes bodily effect through a marked cooking/searing verb.

words.gloss_range: definite plural direct object of the searing verb
words.root_gloss_range: face, direction, aspect, orientation, and public presentation; locally the visible target of anti-relief
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوُجُوهَ}} ({{tr:al-wujūha}}) is the direct object of {{ar:يَشْوِى}} ({{tr:yashwī}}). The definite plural makes faces the collective target, and the root field carries face, direction, and public presentation; after 18:28 speaks of seeking His face, 18:29 turns human faces into the visible surface where judgment is seared.

topics.headline: identity and orientation seared
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the anti-relief chain ends on faces, the visible site of identity, dignity, and direction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on a locally supported payoff: The reader notices that the anti-relief chain ends on faces, the visible site of identity, dignity, and direction.

words.gloss_range: frozen verb of dispraise converting the sensory scene into evaluation
words.root_gloss_range: wretchedness, severity, misery, and hard negative force; locally formal condemnation of the drink
words.prose: {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) is a fixed formula of dispraise. It turns the scalding liquid scene into formal evaluation, condemning the drink with a root field that joins wretchedness and severity, and it begins the paired evaluative cadence that will close the ayah.

topics.headline: formal blame opens the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah stops narrating mechanics and issues a formal verdict.

words.gloss_range: definite specified subject of dispraise pointing back to the muhl-like water
words.root_gloss_range: drinking, intake, imbibing, and provision; locally forced consumption of torment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّرَابُ}} ({{tr:al-sharābu}}) is the specified subject after {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}). The definite article points back to the muhl-like water, so the coda compresses the whole anti-relief chain into one condemned provision word: what should refresh or nourish is named as drink precisely as torment enters the body.

topics.headline: anti-relief named as drink
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that torture is reclassified as intake: the scalding liquid is condemned as the drink.

words.gloss_range: connector joining the two final dispraise clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the drink verdict to the resting-place verdict. The second evaluation is not an afterthought; coordination makes intake and lodging parallel dimensions of one final condemnation.

topics.headline: drink and place condemned together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing judgment covers both what is consumed and where one is lodged.

words.gloss_range: perfect feminine dispraise verb parallel to the first censure formula
words.root_gloss_range: evil, harm, ugliness, shame, and functional badness; locally settled condemnation of the resting-place
words.prose: {{ar:سَآءَتْ}} ({{tr:sāʾat}}) functions as the second dispraise verb and uses a different badness root from {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}). Its perfect form presents the verdict as settled, widening condemnation across moral, visual, and functional badness before the final word specifies the dimension.

topics.headline: settled badness of the lodging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second verdict widens condemnation from wretched drink to vile lodging.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative specification naming the condemned resting/support place
words.root_gloss_range: gentleness, companionship, ease, support, and reclining; locally inverted into hellish lodging
words.prose: {{ar:مُرْتَفَقًا}} ({{tr:murtafaqan}}) is accusative specification after {{ar:سَآءَتْ}} ({{tr:sāʾat}}), naming the dimension of badness as a resting or support place. The root field of gentleness and leaning comfort is inverted at the final word, and the same noun returns for the opposite destination in 18:31, making this closure a forward contrast hook.

topics.headline: comfort word inverted and echoed forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word denies even the comfort implied by resting support and prepares the contrast with 18:31.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "say / the truth from your Lord / whoever wills" at words 1-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fixed truth is made public, then the paired acts of willing place each hearer in a lived relation to it: settled assent or active covering. The symmetry belongs to the responses, not to the truth and its negation.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance externalizes the claim and opens the response event.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the invariant content of the utterance.
Repeated volition distributes the response across two parallel agents.
Heart-settling assent gives one response its inwardly stabilizing function.
Hiding or blocking the truth supplies the contrary response without making a contrary truth.

changed_reading.before: A truth claim is followed by permission to choose belief or disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The fixed declaration exposes a live relation: each will either settles into the disclosed truth or covers it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepared fire, enclosing pavilion, answered distress, liquid, drink, and resting-place sequence at words 12-28.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene assembles the normal affordances of shelter and hospitality, then reverses every function. A prepared enclosure becomes captivity, aid supplies destructive liquid, and drink and resting support become their own condemnations.

activation_trace.role: A present, prepared provision frames the scene as deliberately furnished rather than accidental.
Overmastering enclosure turns a perimeter into inescapable destructive control.
The surrounding pavilion contributes the literal architecture of counterfeit shelter.
Water delivered for drinking supplies the expected service that the scene corrupts.
Molten or sedimented matter replaces potable water and reverses its material function.
Cooking heat makes the offered liquid act outwardly on the drinker's face.
A support for reclining supplies the final comfort-image that the evaluative clause negates.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is described through fire, bad water, and a bad destination.
changed_reading.after: Punishment is a coherent anti-hospitality system: it furnishes shelter, service, drink, and rest only by making each affordance injure its user.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding command constructs a relay from received and fixed wording to the focus command to speak. The hearer may answer the truth, but neither messenger nor hearer is positioned as its editor.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence makes recitation the first link in a transmitted utterance.
Recorded fixation that entails judgment gives the transmitted material binding stability.
Substitution is the literal operation explicitly negated, ruling out replacement in the relay.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible unit that reaches the focus utterance.
The focus command realizes the fixed material as public speech.

structural_cues: 18:27 orders recitation and negates a changer of the words before 18:29 orders the truth to be said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, fixed written words, negated substitution, and then the focus utterance; I infer a source-to-speech relay. A live alternative is that 18:27 asserts textual fidelity without directly delimiting the later choice formula.

changed_reading.before: The speaker independently announces a true proposition and then offers a choice.
changed_reading.after: The speaker relays non-substitutable truth; the permitted divergence lies in reception, not in rewriting what is relayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired wills in the focus are preceded by a contest over gaze, company, remembrance, and desire. Willing therefore reads as an orientation cultivated through attention and allegiance, not as an isolated instant of preference.

activation_trace.role: Repeated wanting sets two rival orientations of desire immediately before the focus's repeated willing.
The seeing eye gives desire an attentional channel that can pass beyond one company toward another object.
A lapse that leaves something outside awareness supplies the contrary attentional state.
The heart locates that lapse inwardly rather than treating choice as only verbal.
The soul's inclination supplies a motive current that can govern conduct.
The focus repeats volition as the point where those prior orientations become response.

structural_cues: 18:28 repeats "they desire / you desire," controls the eyes and obedience, and contrasts remembrance with following desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival desires, gaze, heedlessness, heart, and followed inclination; I infer that these shape the later act of willing. Alternatively, the focus formula may foreground immediate accountability without describing how a will was formed.

changed_reading.before: Each person makes a freestanding choice between belief and disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Each response is still willed, but the will arrives already oriented by what the eye pursues, the heart remembers, and the person follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next two ayat extend belief into intended work whose return is not lost, then answer the focus's condemned resting place with a good place of reclining. The choice branches into practice and returns as an inhabitable outcome.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent reappears as the entry condition for the ensuing active path.
Purposive action carries inward assent into an enacted trajectory.
Loss or disappearance is explicitly negated, making the path's return durable.
Reclining on a support renders the favorable outcome as bodily inhabitation.
The good resting support supplies the positive member of the repeated terminal image.
The same resting-support image is condemned in the focus, closing the negative branch.

structural_cues: 18:30 conjoins belief with good works and negates their loss; 18:31 repeats "murtfaq" after praise against the focus's blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faith-plus-work, preserved return, reclining, and an exact repeated resting-place term; I infer two enacted paths with mirrored terminal affordances. The alternative is a simpler reward/punishment contrast without a process model.

changed_reading.before: Belief or disbelief is an immediate choice followed by externally assigned destinations.
changed_reading.after: The choice initiates a practiced path whose acts remain effective and whose return takes spatial form as either genuine or counterfeit rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The productive garden withholds nothing, yet its owner wrongs himself by voicing a conjecture of independent permanence; his interlocutor names the resulting stance as disbelief. Wrong is relocated from deficient provision to the owner's attribution of self-securing durability.

activation_trace.role: Withholding a due is negated of the garden, establishing full material delivery.
The same withholding image moves to the owner's relation to himself despite that full delivery.
Speech as belief or position turns the owner's permanence claim into a disclosed stance.
Conjecture supplies the insecure epistemic basis of the confident claim.
Unbounded duration is the property the owner assigns to the enclosed asset.
The companion's question diagnoses the stance as a covering of the asset's created dependence.

structural_cues: 18:33 says the gardens withheld nothing; 18:35 calls the owner self-wronging inside one garden; his permanence speech is answered by "did you disbelieve" in 18:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full yield, repeated wronging language, a spoken permanence conjecture, and the companion's disbelief diagnosis; I infer false attribution as the connecting wrong. Alternatively, these lines may portray one wrongdoer without exhausting the focus plural's scope.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are an unspecified class who chose disbelief.
changed_reading.after: A concrete route into the class appears: receive full provision, then cover its dependence by treating present enclosure and yield as self-guaranteeing permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's repeated willing is echoed by the corrective garden utterance, where willing is named together with a denial of independently held power. Human response remains live, but it is not rhetorically presented as its own ground.

activation_trace.role: The recommended utterance publicly corrects the earlier self-securing speech.
The same volition image is explicitly attributed to God within the garden correction.
Strength gathered like strands supplies the capacity whose independent possession is denied.
Repeated human willing remains the focus's immediate response hinge.

structural_cues: 18:39 places "what God willed" beside "no power except through God" after the owner's claims, echoing the focus's repeated "whoever wills."
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact will-root echo and an adjacent denial of independent power; I infer that the focus's human willing is real but non-self-grounding. A live alternative is that 18:39 qualifies possession of the garden only and leaves the focus formula's agency unelaborated.

changed_reading.before: The paired formula can sound like two self-originating sovereign choices.
changed_reading.after: The paired choices remain accountable responses, while the echo warns against construing either will or its capacity as self-owned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence first presents a fruitful perimeter, then removes accessible water and encompasses the fruit until its raised supports collapse. The focus recombines these failed affordances: enclosure survives only as captivity, while water returns only as a destructive provision.

activation_trace.role: A perimeter around a center supplies the garden's initially protective and productive enclosure.
Ordinary water names the sustaining resource whose accessibility can disappear.
Descent into depth removes the garden's sustaining liquid from reach.
Overmastering enclosure reverses the earlier perimeter by making the enclosed fruit the object of ruin.
Collapse makes the loss of the garden's sheltering and productive structure visible.
The same destructive enclosure now takes persons, rather than fruit, as its object.
Delivered water restores availability while corrupting the sustaining function.
Molten sediment gives the restored liquid its destructive material state.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from palms around gardens in 18:32, to inaccessible water in 18:41, to fruit encompassed and trellises collapsed in 18:42, before the focus's enclosed fire and supplied liquid are reread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fruitful perimeter, vanished access to water, destructive encompassing, collapse, and the focus's enclosed fire with supplied molten liquid; I infer a systematic reversal of the garden's affordances. Alternatively, these may be parallel warnings rather than one mapped mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus enclosure and water are independent features of punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are the negative return of a falsely trusted garden system: perimeter becomes captivity, lost water becomes anti-water, and shelter persists only as enclosing ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah of the local sequence returns to truth while assigning governing nearness and the best return to God. The focus's truth from the Lord thus reads not only as accurate content but as the authority whose jurisdiction becomes visible in outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the governing relation asserted at the sequence's end.
Fixed reality repeats the focus truth-root and closes the sequence around it.
A work's return to its doer makes truth's governance legible as recompense.
The last state of a process supplies the temporal horizon in which that governance is judged.
The focus opens with the same fixed-reality image as a declaration from the Lord.

structural_cues: After the garden's loss and failed support, 18:44 joins divine governance, truth, returned reward, and best outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truth-root bookend, divine governance, recompense, and outcome; I infer that the focus declaration carries jurisdiction as well as propositional accuracy. Alternatively, the final "true" may qualify God or governance without expanding the semantic role of focus truth.

changed_reading.before: Truth is chiefly the content of the opening declaration.
changed_reading.after: Truth also names the governing order that outlasts rival shelters and becomes manifest in what actions return and how they end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links desire for God's face with human faces exposed to heat. It remains anchored in the repeated face-root and the focus's roasting verb, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial counter-image, not as an identity between the faces or a claim that the former desire causes the latter fate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus liquid roasts the faces at words 23-24, while 18:28 orients desire toward God's face.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination make the desired face the orienting end of attention.
The bodily front becomes the exposed surface on which the destructive answer lands.
Heat-cooking supplies the action that turns frontal orientation into bodily exposure.

changed_reading.before: The faces are merely body parts injured by the liquid.
changed_reading.after: The faces can also register a negative directional image: instead of desire being oriented beyond the self, the self's own front becomes the surface it cannot turn away from.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the packet's combined aid-and-rain branch from a different root into the focus's branchless distress-and-response construction. It remains anchored in that repeated focus construction and its cited water-to-heat chain, but should be rendered as an abductive anti-rescue analogy, never as a claim that ن ص ر and غ و ث are lexically identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branchless "they seek aid / they are aided" construction at words 19-20 is answered with water that becomes molten and roasting.

activation_trace.role: Aid figured as rain or relief is grammatically denied, priming the expectation of rescuing water.
Water is actually delivered, imitating the medium of relief while reversing its purpose.
Molten sediment corrupts the relief-medium at the level of material substance.
Roasting heat completes the conversion of a rescue response into injury.

changed_reading.before: A request for help receives a cruelly unsuitable drink.
changed_reading.after: The answer structurally mimics rainlike relief while withholding rescue: its medium arrives, but its saving function is inverted into harm.

strongest_changes: The choice formula became a response to non-substitutable relayed truth rather than permission to edit the truth.
Willing became an attention-shaped orientation that enters practice and returns as a mirrored habitat.
The garden sequence turned enclosure, water, aid, and rest into one reversible affordance system, clarifying the focus as anti-hospitality.
The owner's permanence speech supplied a concrete path from full provision to self-wronging disbelief.
summary.what_was_special: Exact repetitions and material reversals carried more activation than broad themes: شاء, ظلم, أحاط, حق, and مرتفق linked speech, agency, enclosure, and outcome, while the branchless aid construction was preserved without a fabricated citation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 18:39 constrains human willing generally or only corrects speech about the garden.
Whether the enclosure and water correspondences form an intended unified mechanism or several adjacent contrasts.
Whether the face-root counter-image is rhetorically active or only a lexical coincidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Choice occurs inside announced reality, not outside consequence.** `ح ق ق` B001 (“firm truth against falsehood”) is sourced from the Lord before the paired acts of willing. The garden owner’s choices are later enclosed by destruction (18:32–44), and the final workers discover their supposedly good making was loss (18:103–106). I infer that freedom selects a relation to truth but does not manufacture the surrounding causal order. The encircling fire externalizes the enclosure already chosen.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:103–106 showed the final enclosure of freely chosen but misoriented work, sharpening consequence without coercing choice.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An enclosure that inverts hospitality.** `س ر د ق/B001` is an encircling pavilion or enclosure. The fixed sequence gives enclosure, a plea for aid, a supplied drink, and finally `مُرْتَفَقًا`; 18:31 answers with garments, reclining supports, and `حَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا`, while 18:32 places productive gardens inside encircling palms. I infer a shared hospitality architecture whose functions have been reversed: cover traps, response harms, and support torments. The fire reads as an anti-lodging, not merely a surrounding flame.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:31 reused `مُرْتَفَقًا` for genuine support, and 18:32 supplied a productive enclosure, making the fixed pavilion an exact anti-hospitality structure.

baseline.text: De ki: Gerçek Rabbinizdendir. Artık dileyen inansın, dileyen inkâr etsin. Biz haksızlık edenler için duvarları kendilerini kuşatan bir ateş hazırladık. Yardım isterlerse yüzleri kavuran erimiş maden gibi bir suyla yardım edilir. Ne kötü içecek ve ne kötü dinlenme yeri!

Ateşin kuşatması ve yardım suyunun yüzleri yakması, sığınma ve ağırlama düzenini tersine çeviren bir çevre oluşturur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Refuge and final states are staged as prepared reception, with facility, enclosure, drink, clothing, seating, and residence defining whether reception protects, torments, or gives rest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cave, punishment, and reward share a hospitality grammar whose provisions are morally differentiated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Relief Requests Intensify the Hostile Enclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire surrounds like a pavilion, and a request for drink is answered by a liquid whose heat attacks the face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; physical encirclement `ح و ط:B001/m01`; surrounding pavilion `س ر د ق:B001/m01`; appeal for relief `غ و ث:B001/m01`; offered liquid `م و ه:B001/m01`; molten dregs `م ه ل:B003/m01`; roasting heat `ش و ي:B001/m01`; drinking `ش ر ب:B001/m01`; hostile resting facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (the encircling pavilion of fire, plea for relief, scalding drink, and evil resting place)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Every ordinary sign of reception is inverted. Shelter confines, service answers distress with further injury, and the designated place of rest becomes part of the punishment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Refuge and final states are staged as prepared reception, with facility, enclosure, drink, clothing, seating, and residence defining whether reception protects, torments, or gives rest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cave, punishment, and reward share a hospitality grammar whose provisions are morally differentiated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Usable Refuge Prefigures the Resting-Place Contrast
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The cave affair is first supplied with a beneficial facility, after which the same resting-place sense evaluates the fiery enclosure and the reclining garden in opposite directions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; opening and spreading `ن ش ر:B001/m01`; usable facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`; burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:16 (mercy spread and the affair furnished with a useful facility); 18:29 (evil resting facility); 18:31 (good resting facility)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical recurrence makes the cave more than a hiding place. It establishes a functional measure for later destinations: a place is judged by whether its arrangement actually serves those received into it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Boundaries Are Judged by the Traffic They Control
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Thresholds, covers, walls, and enclosures take their moral polarity from what they admit, preserve, obstruct, or trap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The whole-surah pattern places physical architecture and sensory reception under one functional test without erasing their distinct scenes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Punitive Enclosure Blocks Relief, Response, and Escape
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire surrounds like a pavilion, false allies remain across an obstructing separation without answering, and Hell stands prepared as final lodging.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: physical encirclement `ح و ط:B001/m01`; surrounding pavilion `س ر د ق:B001/m01`; appeal for relief `غ و ث:B001/m01`; obstructing barrier `و ب ق:B001/m01`; inescapable entrapment `و ب ق:B003/m01`; responsive answer `ج و ب:B003/m01`; route of diversion `ص ر ف:B001/m01`; prepared lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (encircling fire and failed relief); 18:52-53 (unanswered summons, barrier, and no diversion); 18:102 (Hell prepared as lodging)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Unlike protective boundaries, this enclosure is hostile because every desired crossing fails. Aid does not enter, allies do not answer across the separation, and occupants do not find a route out.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Fire Reverses from Punitive Enclosure to Protective Fabrication
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Burning heat takes its moral function from the process it serves, either trapping and receiving the condemned or transforming material into protection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Fire is not assigned one fixed polarity; disciplined use reverses its role without weakening its force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Punitive Fire Encloses and Removes Diversion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire first surrounds its occupants and later appears to the guilty as an unavoidable destination with no route away.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (fire as encircling pavilion); 18:53 (fire seen, falling expected, and no diversion)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The fire's punitive force lies in convergence of approach and enclosure. It is both what surrounds and what can no longer be avoided.

concept_gloss.text: konuşma organı

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.branch_image_ar: قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme kalıbını bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma ve onu benimseme anlamında açıklar. Bu, sadece sözlü ifade veya içte kalmış söz değil, bağlı olunan düşünce veya inanç yönelimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım yalnız görüş veya mezhep benimseme kalıbına bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir görüşe, mezhebe veya düşünce çizgisine inanıp onu benimsemek anlamındaki kalıp kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir görüş veya inancı benimsemektir.
Kullanım söz söylemeyi değil, kişinin bağlı olduğu düşünce veya mezhebi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, bir görüşe veya mezhebe inanma anlamındaki kalıp kullanımını verir.

concept_gloss.text: görüş benimseme

error_profile.preserves: Görüşe inanma ve benimseme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin belli bir düşünceye bağlılığı anlatıldığında doğal çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Benimseme ve bağlı görüş anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal din, yol veya izlenen topluluk düzeni anlamındaki daha nesnel sistemi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de inanç ve izlenen yol alanına girebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişinin bağlılık eylemidir; komşu dal bağlı olunan sistem veya yolun adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir görüşe inanma veya onu benimsemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal söylenmemiş iç sözdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iç zihinsel alanla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bağlı olunan görüş belirleyicidir; komşu dalda yalnız dışa vurulmamış söz veya anlam vardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: للاعتقاد نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
قُلَّة الجبل وأعلى كل شيء، ورأس الإنسان، وقبيعة السيف
القُلَّة إناء كالجرة الكبيرة، ومنها قلال هجر والحباب العظام
حمل الشيء واحتماله، وارتفاعه أو نهوضه، وارتحال القوم ظاعنين
القِلُّ رعدة أو انتفاض يأخذ الإنسان من فزع أو غضب
القلقلة والتقلقل: صوت الحركة، وتحريك الشيء حتى يتحرك ويضطرب، وقلة الثبوت في المكان

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bu dalı yanlışın karşıtı olan doğruluk, gerçekliğe uygunluk, kesin olarak bilme ve sözün gerçek anlamında kullanılması çevresinde kurar. Verilen dal kimliği bu ortak çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kullanımlar doğruluk ve gerçekliğe uygunluk çekirdeğini taşır; yemin bildiren kalıp yalnız kendi söz dizimi içinde değerlendirilir ve dalın genel anlamına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşüncenin, sözün ya da durumun gerçekten var olana uygun düşmesi ve bu nedenle yanlışın karşısında doğru, sağlam ve kesin sayılmasıdır. Söz bakımından ayrıca eğretilemenin karşısındaki gerçek anlamı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gerçekte var olana uygun düşen şey doğru ve sağlamdır.
Bir konuyu araştırıp doğruluğundan kesin biçimde emin olma bu çekirdeğin bilgi alanındaki uzantısıdır.
Bir sözün eğretileme olmadan ilk konulduğu anlamda kullanılması, dil alanındaki özel görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, yanlışın karşısındaki doğruluğu gerçekliğe uygunlukla açıklar; kesin olarak öğrenmeyi ve sözün eğretilemesiz gerçek anlamını da aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.text: gerçekliğe uygun, kesin doğruluk
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düşüncenin, sözün veya durumun gerçekten var olana uygun ve yanlışın karşıtı olduğunu bütün çekirdeğiyle anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçekliğe uygunluk, doğruluk ve kesinlik öğelerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün ya da yargının yanlış olmadığını belirten günlük bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yanlışın karşısında bulunma ve gerçekliğe uygunluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kesin bilgi ile gerçek anlam kullanımını tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün eğretileme değil, ilk ve doğrudan anlamında kullanıldığını belirtirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dilsel kullanımın eğretilemesiz ve yerli yerinde oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel doğruluk ve kesin bilgi yönlerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle söylenen sözün içten olana ve bildirilen olguya uygunluğuna odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yanlışın karşısında gerçek olana uygun bulunmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın alanı söz doğruluğundan geniştir; komşu dal ise özellikle sözün yalana karşı doğruluğunu ve konuşanın içiyle uyuşmasını belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir şeyin doğru ve gerçekliğe uygun olma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruluğu araştırma, onaylama, kanıtlama veya görünür kılma işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin doğru sayılması çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada anlatılan bir durum ve niteliktir; komşu dalda ise o niteliği belirleyen ya da başkasına gösteren bir işlem vardır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحق نقيض الباطل، والصحة، واليقين، والحقيقة، ومطابقة الاعتقاد أو القول أو الفعل لما هو ثابت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحق نقيض الباطل (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ أصل الحق المطابقة والموافقة (mufradat)؛ حققت الأمر وأحققته إذا تحققته وصرت منه على يقين (sihah)؛ الحقيقة خلاف المجاز (sihah)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وجوب الشيء ولزومه، وكون المرء حقيقا أو محقوقا به، والإيجاب والاستيجاب والاستحقاق.
يدخل فيه الحق والحقوق والحقة بمعنى الحق الخاص، والأحقية بين أصحاب المطالبة، والاستحقاق بمعنى ملك الحق على غيره.

branches.branch_image_ar: محاقة يدعي كل طرف فيها الحق
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حاقه وحاققته وتحاق القوم واحتقوا، أي تخاصموا وادعى كل واحد أن الحق معه، ومنه نزق الحقاق.
يدخل فيه أحققت وحققت بمعنى أثبت الحق أو حكمت بكونه حقا أو صدقت القول، وإحقاق الحق بإظهار الأدلة أو إكمال الأمر.
يدخل فيه الحاقة اسما للقيامة أو الساعة لأنها تحق الأمور أو تحق كل إنسان بعمله أو يحق فيها الجزاء.
يدخل فيه حقيقة الرجل وما يحق عليه أن يحميه أو يلزمه الدفاع عنه، ومعه الراية والحرمة والفناء حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الحق والحقة من الإبل إذا استكمل الثالثة ودخل في الرابعة واستحق الحمل أو الركوب، وحق اللقاح ووقت الضرب، وسمن الناقة أو المال عند تمام الربيع حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الطعنة المحتقة والطعن النافذ إلى الجوف أو الذي لا زيغ فيه، وما يقابله المشرم الذي يجرح ولا ينفذ.

branches.branch_image_ar: إحكام رصين في نسج أو كلام
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الثوب المحقق المحكم النسج، والكلام المحقق الرصين، وإحكام الشيء وتصحيحه.
يدخل فيه الحق ملتقى العظمين أو حق الورك والوابلة، والحقة من خشب أو عاج، وحق الباب، وحاق الرأس أو الشتاء بمعنى الوسط، وحق الكهول بمعنى بيت العنكبوت.
يدخل فيه الحقحقة في السير، أي الشدة التي تتعب الظهر أو تحمل الضعيف على ما لا يطيق.
يدخل فيه أحقت أو استحقت الناقة سمنا أو لقاحا، وأحق القوم إذا سمن مالهم، واحتق المال إذا انتهى سمنه.

branches.branch_image_ar: أحق من الخيل يطابق خطوه أو يشتد بدنه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأحق من الخيل الذي لا يعرق أو يطبق حافر رجليه موضع حافر يديه، وما جاوره من احتق الفرس أي ضمر.

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları gerçekliğe uygun doğruluktan zorunluluk, kişisel pay, çekişme ve doğrulamaya; ayrıca koruma, deve yaşı, delici saplanış, sağlam kuruluş, sert sürüş, semirme ve ata özgü kullanımlara uzanır. Bazı dallar uygunluk ve yerli yerine gelme düşüncesiyle bağlanabilse de somut adlar ve hayvan terimleri çok dallı bir yapı oluşturur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان
يدخل فيه الرباني لرئيس الملاحين

root_profile.summary: Kök, sahiplik ve yetiştirmeden topluluk, aile bağı, kalıcılık, bulut, yiyecek maddesi, sözleşme, bitki, su, hayvan sürüsü, dil bilgisel öğe ve gemi yönetimine uzanan on yedi ayrı anlam dalı taşır. Dalların çoğu yönetme, bir araya getirme veya süreklilik çağrışımlarıyla gevşekçe ilişkilense de sözlükte bağımsız sınırlar gerektirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde artma ve yükselme bulunur; bu çekirdek yükselmiş araziye, işlemde anaparayı aşan koşullu fazlalığa, yükselip sıkışan soluğa ve beslenerek büyümeye uzanır. Ayrıca uyluk kökü anatomisi ile baba tarafından yakın hane halkını anlatan dar bir ifade, merkezden ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

Ayrıca gerektiğinde kullanılmak üzere sürekli elde tutulan özel bir kap veya takım da bu alanda adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Bir şey yakın, el altında ve gereksinim doğduğunda kullanılabilecek durumdadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem bulunma durumunu hem hazırlama işlemini hem de hazırlanan gereci kapsayan daha geniş bir anlam örgüsüdür. Komşu dal ise yaklaşan bir olay için somut önlem ve birikim oluşturmayı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önceden saklanan donanım, stok ve bakım gereçlerinin tutulduğu kap odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin yapabilir veya gücü yeter durumda olmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bir şeyi önceden hazırlayıp elde bulundurma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyin önceden hazırlanması ve gerektiği anda kişinin yanında bulunması iki dalda da vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hazırlama ve elde bulundurma yönleri büyük ölçüde örtüşür. Komşu dal yeterlik durumuna uzanırken odak dal hazırlanmış gereç, stok ve özel kap adlarına uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin yakın bulunması ve önceden hazırlanması odak dalın kurucu parçalarıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Araç ve gereç sınıfını, su kabı gibi hazırlık amacı taşımayan nesnelere de genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: iş için kullanılan araç ve donanım
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir işi gerçekleştirmek üzere kullanılan gereç ve donanım alanında kesişirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda araç, gereksinimden önce hazırlanıp elde tutulmasıyla anlam kazanır. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise nesnenin işlevsel araç veya gereç olmasıdır; ön hazırlık zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: El altında bulunma, saklanan donanım ve özel kap anlamları yalnız odak dalda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hazırlanmayı özellikle kışa yönelik bir hazırlık ifadesi içinde sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelecekteki bir gereksinim için önceden hazırlanma anlamı iki dalda da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kışa hazırlanma bağlamına bağlı özel bir kullanımdır. Odak dal herhangi bir iş için hazırlamayı, hazır bulunmayı ve ortaya çıkan gereç adlarını birlikte kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hazırlama işlemi, donanım ve saklanan özel kap anlamları odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: El altında olmayı kalıplaşmış bir beden ve bağ imgesiyle, çabukluk vurgusuyla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyin yakın, elde ve gecikmeden kullanılabilir bulunması ortak anlam alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal, hemen erişilebilirliği kalıplaşmış bir anlatımla bildirir. Odak dal bu durumun yanında önceden hazırlama ve hazırlanan nesne sonuçlarını da sözlük anlamının parçası yapar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hazırlama, araç ve hemen erişilebilirlik sınırlarını en iyi gösteren beş komşu yayımlandı. Aynı kökün at, oğlak ve kap dalları ile anlamsal çekirdeği paylaşmayan uzak adaylar yinelenen ya da yararsız karşılaştırma oluşturmamaları için dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عتيد بمعنى حاضر أو قريب أو معد، وأعتد الشيء بمعنى هيأه وأعده، والعتاد بمعنى العدة والأهبة والآلة، والعتيدة لما لا يبرح عند الحاجة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على حضور وقرب (maqayis)؛ عتد الشيء وهو يعتد عتادا فهو عتيد حاضر (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ العتيد الشيء المعد (ayn)؛ العتيد الشئ الحاضر المهيا (sihah)؛ العتاد الشيء الذي تعده لأمر ما وتهيئه له (tahdhib)؛ العتاد ادخار الشيء قبل الحاجة إليه (mufradat)؛ العتيدة التي يكون فيها الطيب والأدهان (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib;jamhara)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه فرس عتد أو عتيد إذا كان معدا للركوب أو الجري، شديدا تام الخلق أو حاضر العدو
يدخل فيه العتود من أولاد المعز أو الجدي إذا رعى وقوي أو استكرش أو بلغ السفاد، مع اختلاف المصادر في حد السن
يدخل فيه إطلاق العتاد على القدح أو القدح الضخم، وما فسر معه بالعسف والصحن
